rules.name: abstract_math_placeholder
rules.description: Target abstract contains @xmath placeholders for math that was removed upstream and cannot be recovered.

rules.name: abstract_other_conversion_placeholder
rules.description: Target abstract contains other LaTeX-conversion placeholders (@xcite, @noop, @url, ...).

rules.name: abstract_latex_or_markup_residue
rules.description: Target abstract contains LaTeX commands, figure-caption fragments, [ firstpage ] or macro residue.

rules.name: abstract_metadata_appended
rules.description: Target abstract has PACS numbers, keywords, e-mail addresses or subject headings appended.

rules.name: abstract_bibliography_reference
rules.description: Target abstract cites numbered references ([ n ]) from a bibliography that is not in the row.

rules.name: abstract_incomplete_ending
rules.description: Target abstract does not end with a complete sentence (appended keyword/affiliation lists or truncation).

rules.name: abstract_too_short
rules.description: Target abstract has fewer than 15 words.

rules.name: article_not_paper_body
rules.description: Input article has fewer than 300 words (acknowledgements, references or a fragment, not the paper body).

rules.name: article_math_placeholder_density
rules.description: More than 10% of input article tokens are unrecoverable @xmath placeholders.

rules.name: abstract_copied_in_article
rules.description: The target abstract appears verbatim in the input article (copy shortcut).

thresholds.threshold_basis: train split distribution only; no model-performance input

recovery.finding: No math expression is recoverable: ccdv/arxiv-summarization stores only @xmathN tokens, abstract numbering is independent of the article, and rows carry no arXiv identifier or title to trace the original LaTeX. No expression was invented or substituted.
